scope: Mandatory pre-intent HA reload validation and actual Raft member generation validator; production caller integration remains open
checkScope: Distinct checks across final reload and relevant integration suites; repeated runs not double-counted. The HA recovery acknowledgement callback remains a test double; the published-snapshot recovery validation test uses real file-backed Raft storage.
coverage: HA reload requires lock, preflight and durable recovery callbacks
Preflight must return T before any intent or selector mutation
Calling thread must own the actual member mutex; another thread holding it is insufficient
Bind independent expected sender term, snapshot index/term and copied artifact digest
Read current committed/applied/snapshot boundary at invocation; reject stale term, role, index, term regression and unverifiable log state
Exact pending artifact retries permitted after election, including already published boundary, without rolling back newer commits
Pending snapshot envelope membership/application presence and canonical artifact reference validated
Explicit recover mode matches published snapshot loaded by recover-raft-node from an fsynced file WAL before suffix replay
Fresh transfer cannot impersonate equal-index published recovery
Conflicting uncommitted tail may be replaced; validator leaves log and application unchanged
Mutable input digest cannot alter a constructed validator
memoryScope: 384 MiB heap, cached compilation, 64 MiB ConfigMap payload capture/validation/rebased materialization/same-store reload. Standalone path; no production incoming snapshot or simultaneous active cluster workload.
remaining: Authenticated production artifact transfer and durable artifact placement/retention
Ingress/controller/node-RPC quiescence and transport member-lock ordering
Register production snapshot/restore callbacks and coordinate WAL adoption/replay/startup
Automatic compaction and constrained-heap disconnected-member real-process acceptance
